title: Object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop with four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0104, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.0104, 0.0) and ends at (0.0104, 0.0104). The third line starts at (0.0104, 0.0104) and ends at (0.0, 0.0104). Finally, the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0104) and returns to the origin (0.0, 0.0). After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.0104 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting object is a vertical rod with a rectangular base, measuring 0.010416666666666666 units in length and width, and 0.75 units in height. The object has a smooth surface and sharp edges.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch for the rectangular base
sketch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0104, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0104, 0.0104)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0104)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular base
rectangular_base = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Create the cylindrical top
cylindrical_top = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0.75)
    .circle(0.0052)  # Radius of the cylinder
    .extrude(0.25)   # Height of the cylinder
)

# Combine the rectangular base and the cylindrical top
r = rectangular_base.union(cylindrical_top)

import cadquery as cq

# Lower cylindrical section
lower_radius = 0.0078
lower_height = 0.745

# Upper cylindrical section
upper_radius = 0.0060
upper_height = 0.255

# Build the lower section
lower = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(lower_radius).extrude(lower_height)

# Build the upper section on top of the lower one
upper = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, lower_height))
    .circle(upper_radius)
    .extrude(upper_height)
)

# Combine the two sections into a single solid
r = lower.union(upper)
